review: The owner-supplied 1536x1024 kitten infographic was preserved as the source and a 900x600 review derivative was planned at its native 3:2 ratio.
The frequencies, merge order, prefix-free explanation, Kraft equality and worked decoding example were checked for beginner-level Huffman coding accuracy.
The fixture was regenerated as exactly three responsive native pages: visual overview, tree construction, then decoding and recall.
The first page deliberately budgets most of its area for the attached infographic instead of squeezing it into the prior photosynthesis layout.
The fixture is frozen demo content; playback never calls a provider or presents it as a live response.
